expressions.bm_casual: Betulkan masalah teknikal / Settlekan problem tech

vocabulary_focus.concept: To go online/connect to the internet

expressions.en: To go online/connect to the internet

expressions.cn: 开发/创建 (新系统/解决方案)

work.scenario: Our team needs to update the project management software by next week. We also need to develop a new reporting system for the client. If there are any technical issues during the update, please make sure we have a plan to troubleshoot quickly. We're also looking to implement a new data privacy policy.

life.scenario: My phone apps keep crashing. I need to update them. Also, my internet connection isn't stable; I can't go online properly. I really need to back up all my photos before something happens to my phone. Maybe I should ask my cousin to help me fix this technical problem.

tech.scenario: The development team is working hard to develop a new AI solution. We're planning to implement several new features in the next release. Before we launch, we must ensure all data is properly backed up and conduct thorough troubleshooting for any potential technical problems. We also need to update our server infrastructure.
